summary: BNB Standard Corporation filed an 8-K reporting a corporate name change from CEA Industries Inc. to BNB Standard Corporation, effective 12:01 a.m. Pacific on September 29, 2026, via a Certificate of Amendment filed with Nevada on September 21, 2026, with a delayed effective date. The board approved the amendment September 18, 2026; no stockholder approval was required under NRS 78.390(8). Restated Articles were filed September 29, 2026. The common stock continues on Nasdaq under BNC, warrants under BNCWW and BNCWZ, with unchanged CUSIPs and no holder action required. This is a routine administrative change, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
